topic: Someone discovers their partner has been writing a novel about them
text: You think you know someone, then one day you're flipping through their drawers, looking for who knows what, and there it is. A stack of papers, typed up neat, this whole other world painted with words. Your world, but not. Twisted, magnified, or worse, shrunk down to fit their version of you. And there you are, page after page, living a life you never lived, said things you never said. You shut the pages, tuck them back, and the room's too small, the walls closing in. You swallow hard, fists tight enough to make the knuckles white. Time to have a talk, see how much of the story’s real, and how much is just the kind of fiction they sell.
